title: Rotary Evaporator Vacuum Distillation & Solvent Condenser Drops
description: Intermediate chemical synthesis and analytical module analyzing rotary evaporator vacuum distillation & solvent condenser drops.
learning_objectives: Master professional Present Perfect Continuous (duration) in organic API synthesis and QC analysis
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in rotary evaporator vacuum distillation & solvent condenser drops
Demonstrate precision in HPLC, Karl Fischer, and pharmacopeial compliance documentation

questions.prompt: Before starting the automated HPLC injection sequence, the analyst noted that the crude synthetic API batch _____.

explanations.correct: Past Perfect Passive ('had been dissolved') correctly expresses priority before the past action 'noted'.
explanations.wrong_A: Past Simple ('was dissolved') fails to indicate completion prior to 'noted'.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Perfect ('has been dissolved') cannot connect to a past reference frame.
explanations.wrong_D: 'didn't dissolve' is active voice; analytical reagents and samples are acted upon passively.
